**[cGAS integrates Toll-like receptor signaling in platelets to promote thromboinflammation](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PPR1358964)** *(from Hematology/platelet biology and sepsis thromboinflammation)*  
*Bidias Amel Renaud; Arsenault Laurence; Fleury Samuel; Welman Mélanie; Osouf Mél* —  2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `cGAS-STING, NLRP3, POLG-mtDNA, mito-ROS-NF-kB, NF-kB-NLRP3-priming, clinical-phenotype, treatment-target`  
> Shows that TLR-triggered mtDNA release into the cytosol (MCU-dependent, with mitochondrial ROS and loss of membrane potential) activates a platelet-intrinsic cGAS-STING axis that drives pyroptosis, thrombocytopenia and systemic inflammation. This closely parallels the BLUE stream (mtDNA escape to cGAS-STING) and the mito-ROS/pyroptosis arms of the SAMHD1 A565T model, and it suggests a platelet/thromboinflammation angle for the family's ME/CFS, long COVID and post-viral phenotypes. It has no SAMHD1, dNTP or VDAC1 data, so it is a mechanistic analog rather than direct evidence.  
DOI: 10.64898/2026.11.02.763723

**[CKMT1 Counteracts VDAC1 Oligomerization-Induced Neuronal Pyroptosis Through Steric Hindrance in Ischemic Stroke.](https://europepmc.org/article/MED/42985831)** *(from Neurology / cerebrovascular (ischemic stroke neuroscience))*  
*Wang Xiaoyu; Shi Sai; Wu Jianghui; Zhang Jingge; Li Shuqin* —  2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `VDAC1, treatment-target, POLG-mtDNA, other`  
> The paper shows that VDAC1 oligomerization drives mtDNA leakage and inflammasome activation (AIM2 rather than cGAS-STING or NLRP3), that VBIT-4 blocks this cascade, and that CKMT1 is a new endogenous inhibitor of VDAC1 oligomerization. This maps onto the BLUE stream (VDAC1 macropore, cytosolic mtDNA) and gives a new druggable or endogenous regulatory node. It involves no SAMHD1, no interferon or cGAS-STING data, and it is a stroke model with AIM2 as the readout, which keeps it indirect.  
DOI: 10.1002/advs.78611
